data.businessDescription: Nokian Renkaat Oyj engages in the manufacture of tyres. It operates through the following segments: Passenger Car Tyres, Heavy Tyres, Vianor, and Other Operations. The Passenger Car Tyres segment covers the development and production of summer and winter tyres for cars and vans. The Heavy Tyres segment comprises tyres for forestry machinery, and special tyres for agricultural machinery, tractors, and industrial machinery. The Vianor segment refers to the tyre chain, which sells car, van, and truck tyres. The Other Operations segment includes retreading and truck tyre business. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Nokia, Finland.

Vidrala SA engages in the manufacture and sale of glass containers for the packaging of food products. It operates through the Continental Europe; UK and Ireland segments. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Llodio, Spain.

Dom Development SA engages in the development of property. It offers apartments, commercial premises, and turnkey interior finishing in Warsaw, Tricity, Kraków, and Wroclaw. The company was founded by Jaroslaw Szanajca in 1996 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Real Estate Investment and Services

data.businessDescription: Gränges AB is an aluminium technology company, which develops lighter and more sustainable aluminium products and solutions. It operates through the following segments: Gränges Eurasia, Gränges Americas, and Other and Eliminations. The Gränges Eurasia segment offers heat exchanger materials for the automotive industry. The Gränges Americas segment provides rolled aluminium products for the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) industry. The Other and Eliminations segment manages group functions and other activities which cannot be allocated to the business areas. The company was founded on July 30, 1896 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Pharming Group NV is a holding company, which engages in the development of pharmaceutical products for the treatment of rare diseases and unmet medical needs. The firm offers RUCONEST, which is a recombinant human C1-esterase inhibitor for the treatment of acute hereditary angioedema. It operates through the following segments: RUCONEST®, Joenja®, Europe, and Rest of the World. The company was founded on November 11, 1988, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.

Vétoquinol SA operates as a global animal health company. It supplies drugs and nonmedicinal products for the livestock (cattle and pigs) and pet (dogs and cats) markets. The firm designs, develops and sells veterinary drugs and non-medicinal products in Europe, the Americas and the Asia Pacific region. It also manufactures antibiotic, anti-inflammatory, cardiology, and nephrology drugs. The company was founded by Joseph Frechin in 1933 and is headquartered in Lure, France.

Telecom Plus Plc is a holding company, which engages in the provision of fixed wire and mobile telecommunication services. The company was founded on October 9, 1996 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Electric and Natural Gas Utilities

data.businessDescription: Danone SA engages in the food processing industry. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe; North America; China, North Asia & Oceania; and Rest of the World. The company was founded on February 2, 1899 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

Hammerson Plc engages in the investment, development, and management of shopping centers, retail parks, and offices. It operates through the following geographical segments: United Kingdom, France, and Ireland. The United Kingdom segment consists of shopping centers, retail parks, and other. The France segment involves in the development activities. The Ireland segment includes shopping centers. The company was founded by Lewis W. Hammerson in 1942 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

data.entityProperName: Koncar - Distribution and Special Transformers, Inc.
data.businessDescription: Koncar-Distributivni I Specijalni Transformatori dd engages in the designing, manufacture, sale, and distribution of power transformers. Its products are oil distribution Transformers, Dry distribution transformers, Medium power transformers, and Special transformers. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Zagreb, Croatia.

Henkel AG & Co. KGaA engages in the production, sale, and distribution of home and beauty care products. The firm also provides adhesive technology solutions. It operates through the Adhesive Technologies and Consumer Brands segments. The Adhesive Technologies segment sells adhesives, sealants, and functional coatings for consumers, craftsmen, and industrial applications. The Consumer Brands segment offers branded products for consumers and professional applications for the hairdressing business that includes products for hair care, styling and coloring, as well as detergents and fabric softeners. The company was founded by Fritz Henkel on September 26, 1876 and is headquartered in Dusseldorf, Germany.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Adhesive, Sealant, Coating and Paint Products

data.businessDescription: Dunelm Group Plc is a homewares retailer through stores, over the internet, and via a catalogue. It provides various houseware products, including bathroom ware, bedding, beds and mattresses, blinds, fabric and sewing, curtains, storage, rugs and doormats, pictures and mirrors, cushions and throws, lighting, laundry, duvets and pillows, home decor and furniture. The company was founded by William Adderley and Jean Adderley in 1979 and is headquartered in Charnwood, the United Kingdom.

Azelis Group NV is an investment holding company engaged in the provision of services relating to the specialty chemicals and food ingredients industry. It operates through the following segments: Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), Americas, Asia-Pacific, and Group Holding and Other. The Americas segment includes operating companies in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The Asia-Pacific segment consists of operating companies in Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Pacific region. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Antwerp, Belgium.

IONOS Group SE offers web hosting and cloud solutions. It is an international digitization partner and a trusted cloud enabler serving the needs of SMBs, freelance professionals, larger enterprise customers, and private users. The firm also offers a broad portfolio of products and services, including web presence and productivity solutions as well as cloud solutions. IONOS Group was founded on November 8, 2016 and is headquartered in Montabaur, Germany.

Big Yellow Group Plc is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the provision of self-storage and related services. It operates through the Self-Storage and Related Services segment. The company was founded by Nicholas John Vetch, James Ernest Gibson, and Philip Adrian Burks in September 1998 and is headquartered in Bagshot, the United Kingdom.

Morgan Sindall Group plc engages in the provision of construction and infrastructure services. It operates through the following segments: Partnership Housing, Mixed Use Partnerships, Fit Out, Construction, Infrastructure, and Property Services. The Partnership Housing segment focuses on working in partnerships with local authorities and housing associations. The Mixed Use Partnerships segment focuses on transforming the urban landscape through partnership working and the development of multi-phase sites and mixed-use placemaking. The Fit Out segment specializes in fit out and refurbishment in commercial, central and local government offices and further education. The Construction segment focuses on education, healthcare, commercial, industrial, leisure and retail markets. The Infrastructure segment focuses on energy, nuclear, rail, highways, water and defense markets. The Property Services segment provides response and planned maintenance services for social housing and the wider public sector. The company was founded on July 20, 1953 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Dätwyler Holding AG engages in the provision of supply of system-critical elastomer components for injectable drug delivery systems. It operates through the Healthcare Solutions and Industrial Solutions segments. The Healthcare Solutions segment offers system-critical components for containers and delivery systems for injectable drugs and diagnostics in the pharmaceutical and medical markets. The Industrial Solutions segment manufactures customized system-critical components for applications in the mobility, food, beverage, and general industry markets. The company was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Altdorf, Switzerland.

data.businessDescription: Embla Medical hf is a global orthopaedics company, which engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of non-invasive orthopedic products. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas; Europe Middle-East and Africa; and Americas and Aisa-Pacific. The company was founded by Össur Kristinsson in 1971 and is headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Friedrich Vorwerk Group SE designs, creates and operates energy infrastructure. It operates through the following segments; Natural Gas, Electricity, Clean Hydrogen and Adjacent Opportunities. The Natural Gas segment involves the transportation and transformation of raw natural gas into conditioned natural gas. The Electricity segment is focused on the underground transportation and transformation of electricity produced from climate-friendly, non-fossil energy sources such as wind, solar, water and renewable raw materials. The Clean Hydrogen segment involves the transportation of energy produced from climate-friendly energy sources into clean hydrogen as well as its transportation to end users. The Adjacent Opportunities segment bundles all other projects and partial projects that do not fall into any of the above three segments but require related or similar technological approaches. The company was founded on October 02, 2019 and is headquartered in Tostedt, Germany.

4iG Nyrt engages in the development and adaptation of custom software applications. It operates through the following segments: IT and System Integration Services, Telecommunications Services, and Space Industry and Defense Industry Services. The IT and System Integration Services segment includes software and hardware sales, system operation, and support. The Telecommunications Services segment focuses on the operation of telecommunications-related infrastructure. The Space Industry and Defense Industry Services segment relates to space, aerospace, land systems, weapons and ammunition, and cyber and defense digitalization. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Budapest, Hungary.
